title: Giant raccoons and the toe implant
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Giant raccoons and the toe implant, about unspecified at Fillmore, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh had some a weird experience uh where uh I saw these giant raccoons in my backyard and uh when I was at the house alone one night

plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who studies objects that people believe were implanted in their bodies, says he once had a strange experience at his house in Fillmore, California. Alone one night, he says, he saw giant raccoons in his backyard, and the story ties that night to a small implant found in his toe, with a man named Roger Leer part of the account. If true, it would mean he himself became one of the people he studies.
